title: Get Excited about ML: Predict Car Purchases with Python & Scikit-learn in 5 mins

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to the machine learning Ed course.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 Machine Learning A-Z 課程。

cues.en: Super excited to have you back here on board.
cues.zh: 很高興能和你一起學習。

cues.en: You might be wondering what's up with the timer.
cues.zh: 你可能很好奇，這個計時器是做什麼的。

cues.en: Well, this tutorial is all about getting excited about machine learning, and I've set the challenge of showing you the power of machine learning in under five minutes.
cues.zh: 這堂課要讓你感受機器學習的魅力，我挑戰在五分鐘內，向你展現它的威力。

cues.en: So let's dive straight into it.
cues.zh: 我們馬上開始。

cues.en: You are a data scientist working for a car company, and you've been given this data set with ages, and estimated salaries of potential customers.
cues.zh: 假設你是汽車公司的資料科學家，拿到一份潛在客戶的年齡與估計薪資資料。

cues.en: Your task is to predict which ones of these customers are more likely to purchase a car based on a campaign that the sales division will be running.
cues.zh: 你的任務，是預測在業務部門即將推出的行銷活動中，哪些客戶比較可能買車。

cues.en: The good news is that the sales division also gave you this data set, which is data from a previous campaign.
cues.zh: 好消息是，業務部門也提供了另一份資料，來自過去的一次行銷活動。

cues.en: A very similar campaign they ran in the past, which also has ages and estimated salaries of customers.
cues.zh: 那次活動非常類似，同樣記錄了客戶年齡與估計薪資。

cues.en: But it has an additional column, which says whether that customer purchased the car that they were advertised, or whether they didn't purchase a car.
cues.zh: 但還多了一個欄位，表示客戶是否購買了廣告中的汽車。

cues.en: So this data set is the one we're going to use to build a model, and then we're going to apply that model to this data set.
cues.zh: 我們會用這份資料建立模型，再把模型套用到這一份資料上。

cues.en: And we are going to be using a logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 這次要使用邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: Excited. So am I, Let's dive straight into it.
cues.zh: 興奮嗎？我也是，我們馬上開始。

cues.en: We're going to be using Python, and we're going to be working in Google Co lab, which is a very popular tool.
cues.zh: 我們會使用 Python，並在非常受歡迎的 Google Colab 中操作。

cues.en: As you can see, we have some code pre written here, and we're going to walk through this code and run it step by step, and you'll see the model getting built, which is very exciting.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡已經寫好一些程式，我們會逐步閱讀與執行，看著模型建立起來，非常令人期待。

cues.en: Now, let's take the first step, and we'll load the data sets here.
cues.zh: 第一步，先載入這裡的資料集。

cues.en: Here the data sets.
cues.zh: 這些就是資料集。

cues.en: We're going to click over here, and I'm going to load them up.
cues.zh: 點這裡，把它們上傳。

cues.en: All right, so the data sets are loaded, and we can proceed to our code now.
cues.zh: 好，資料集已載入，現在可以開始執行程式。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: First thing we're going to do, is we're going to import the libraries.
cues.zh: 首先要匯入函式庫。

cues.en: So we're going to open this up, run these libraries, and this will allow us to work with the data.
cues.zh: 打開這段程式並執行，匯入這些函式庫後，就能處理資料。

cues.en: Next, we're going to import the data set into our code so we can work with it there.
cues.zh: 接著，將資料集讀入程式中，方便後續操作。

cues.en: There's, you can see there's a age estimated salary, and whether or not a person purchased.
cues.zh: 可以看到年齡、估計薪資，以及是否購買這幾個欄位。

cues.en: So that's a previous campaign.
cues.zh: 這是先前活動的資料。

cues.en: Then we're going to plot the data set, and see what it's all about.
cues.zh: 接著把資料畫出來，了解它的樣貌。

cues.en: Here we can see the blue dots represent people who purchase.
cues.zh: 藍點代表有購買的客戶。

cues.en: They're usually at a higher age or at a higher salary, and people who didn't purchase are the red dots.
cues.zh: 他們通常年齡較高，或薪資較高；紅點則是沒有購買的人。

cues.en: And of course there's a mix over there as well.
cues.zh: 當然，也有一些點交錯在一起。

cues.en: Now we're going to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 現在要進行特徵縮放。

cues.en: We won't go into detail on what this is all about, it's just a very important step, and you'll learn more about it inside the course for sure.
cues.zh: 目前先不詳細說明，這是很重要的步驟，課程後面一定會深入介紹。

cues.en: And next we're going to train the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 接著，訓練邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Logistic regression model is trained and logistic regression is just one of the models, a very popular one, but definitely they are other ones, which again you'll learn inside the course.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸模型已訓練完成。這是很常用的一種模型，當然還有其他模型，課程中都會學到。

cues.en: We're going to visual the mo, visualize the model results, and this will allow us to see what is going in on in our data, and how the model is being applied to it.
cues.zh: 我們會把模型結果視覺化，看看資料中的情況，以及模型如何套用在資料上。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: There's our logistic regression model applied to the data.
cues.zh: 這就是邏輯斯迴歸模型套用在資料上的結果。

cues.en: As you can see, it's saying that anything above this blue line means that the person will purchase or has purchased the car.
cues.zh: 可以看到，藍線上方代表這個人會購買，或過去曾經購買汽車。

cues.en: Anything below the line means that they won't.
cues.zh: 線下方則代表不會購買。

cues.en: And of course there are some mismatches with the blue and red dots, and that's okay because no model is perfect.
cues.zh: 當然，藍點和紅點有些不符合分類區域，這很正常，因為沒有完美的模型。

cues.en: Those are just errors which are totally normal for models, and in this course you will learn how to pick the right models for the right applications and to minimize those errors.
cues.zh: 這些就是模型常見的誤差，課程會教你依不同應用選擇適當模型，並盡量降低誤差。

cues.en: Next, we're going to import the new project data.
cues.zh: 接著，匯入新專案的資料。

cues.en: And there it is.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: That's our new data that we need to predict.
cues.zh: 這是我們需要預測的新資料。

cues.en: We're going to apply our model to make those predictions, and we will then visualize the predictions to see the results.
cues.zh: 套用模型產生預測，再把預測結果視覺化。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Those are our, our results over here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是結果。

cues.en: And as we can see, the model is saying that anything above this blue line, that those people will, are likely to purchase the car.
cues.zh: 可以看到，模型認為藍線上方的這些人，比較可能購買汽車。

cues.en: Below the blue line are not likely to purchase the car.
cues.zh: 藍線下方的人，則比較不可能購買。

cues.en: So our marketing department can just simply target the people in the blue area, and therefore save on costs, and optimize efforts,
cues.zh: 因此，行銷部門可以直接鎖定藍色區域中的客戶，節省成本、提高效率，

cues.en: focused efforts, and get the best return investment.
cues.zh: 集中資源，取得最佳投資報酬。

cues.en: So there we go. That's how easy it is to apply machine learning models.
cues.zh: 就是這樣，套用機器學習模型就是這麼簡單。

cues.en: As you can see, this took us under five minutes.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我們花了不到五分鐘。

cues.en: And of course, this was a simplified approach.
cues.zh: 當然，這是簡化過的做法。

cues.en: We didn't do many of the steps like splitting the data into a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 有許多步驟沒有做，例如把資料拆成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: We didn't build a confusion matrix, or calculate accuracy ratios, and lots of other nuances all of which you will learn inside the course.
cues.zh: 我們沒有建立混淆矩陣、計算準確率，也略過許多細節，這些都會在課程中學到。

cues.en: But in a nutshell, this is how machine learning works, and this is the power of machine learning which already soon you will be able to apply in your career.
cues.zh: 但簡單來說，這就是機器學習的運作方式，也是你很快就能在職涯中運用的力量。

cues.en: I hope you're excited, and I can't wait to see you inside the course where we will learn a lot, and have lots of fun along the way.
cues.zh: 希望你也感到興奮，我很期待在課程中和你一起學習，享受這段過程。

cues.en: And until next time, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 下次見，在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
